question: How does the all-pervading one run through secret wheels?
premises: all-pervading runs through three-essence-spoked secret wheels
world born and dissolved from which
inference: The all-pervading one runs through the secret wheels; from that the world is born and dissolved by its own play.
plain_english: The all-pervading one runs through the three-essence-spoked secret wheels, from which the world is born and dissolved by its own play.
